description: CA3080 operational transconductance amplifier, single (our model from Intersil's sheet)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-180): the values are Solum Builder's

rating_sources.vs_max: Intersil CA3080/CA3080A data sheet File Number 475.4 (September 1998): Absolute Maximum Ratings, supply voltage 36 V (±18 V)
rating_sources.cm_neg_headroom: Intersil CA3080/CA3080A data sheet File Number 475.4 (September 1998): Electrical Specifications, common-mode input-voltage range 12 to -12 V min (13.6 to -14.6 V typ) at VSUPPLY = ±15 V, so 3 V from each supply
rating_sources.cm_pos_headroom: Intersil CA3080/CA3080A data sheet File Number 475.4 (September 1998): Electrical Specifications, common-mode input-voltage range 12 to -12 V min (13.6 to -14.6 V typ) at VSUPPLY = ±15 V, so 3 V from each supply

datasheet.note: CA3080 peak output current 500 µA typ (350 to 650) at IABC = 500 µA
CA3080 peak output current 5 µA typ at IABC = 5 µA (CA3080A 3 to 7)

package.name: 8-pin DIP
package.source: Intersil CA3080/CA3080A data sheet File Number 475.4 (September 1998), Pinouts (p.1): 1 and 8 NC

fit.sheet: Intersil CA3080/CA3080A data sheet File Number 475.4 (September 1998)
fit.figure: Figure 21, transconductance vs amplifier bias current (25 °C); Figure 22-type bias voltage curve for the bias pin
fit.method: Behavioural OTA: Iout = Iabc·tanh(Vd/2VT) split into source and sink halves, a 2 MHz pole, swing limits and Early term from the table, the bias pin a junction to V- fitted to the bias-voltage figure, base currents fitted to Figure 16. Build script .claude/skills/fit-model/worked/ota/build_ota.py; checks check_ota.py.
fit.note: Where a figure disagrees with the table (output resistance, supply current, peak current), the table wins (D-163). Offsets, CMRR and noise aren't modelled.
